questions.question:
In the following question, a sentence is given in Direct/Indirect speech. Out of the four alternatives choose the one which best expresses the sentence in Indirect/Direct Speech.

Mr. Puri said to me, "Why are you taking down this fence?"

options.text: Mr. Puri asked me why was I taking down this fence.
Mr. Puri asked me why I was taking down that fence.
Mr. Puri said to me that why are you taking down this fence.
Mr. Puri said to me why you were taking down that fence.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 2) i.e. Mr. Puri asked me why I was taking down that fence.**

**While changing direct speech into indirect speech, interrogative sentences should be changed to assertive sentences.**

 
• Option 1) cannot be the correct answer because **a helping verb has been used before the subject**.
 
• In option 3) **why and that are used simultaneously** which is wrong.
 
• In option 4) **said to is not changed into asked**, so, it cannot be the correct answer.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select No improvement.**

__Lot of peoples__ visit this restaurant as its biryani is famous.
questions.solution:
__
 
• Option 2 - **'Much of people'** is** wrong** because **'much'** is used for the **nouns** that are **uncountable **to specify **quantity **whereas in our case - we are referring to** 'people'**- **Countable noun** for which **'many'** **could** have been the** right** usage.

 
 
• e.g: **Much** of the **sugar** was wasted.
 
• e.g: **Many people** visit this restaurant as its biryani is famous.

 
 
 
 
• Option 3- 'A lot of peoples' doesn't make any sense as
 
 
• the noun** 'people'** does **not** take a **plural from** by adding 's'.
 
• People itself is a collective noun consisting of individuals that form the people.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate option is '**A lot of people'**.

Correct sentence: **A lot of people**__ visit this restaurant as its biryani is famous.

(Alternatively: __**Lots of people**__ visit this restaurant as its biryani is famous-could have been the correct usage.)

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All rocks are oceans.

All oceans are balloons.

Some watches are balloons.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some balloons are rocks.

II. Some watches are oceans.

III. All oceans are rocks.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow.
Only conclusions I and III follow.

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/348f982b0f11da79622a28648c7ff0060dd4610e466d7b8200b60c592ba2a0d8.png] 

Concept:

1) We have to check the conclusions are 100% match with the statement. If the conclusion is 100% match with the given statement then the conclusion is true. If there is a 1% chance of not following the statement then the conclusion is considered to be false.

2) The possibility case can be considered to be "false" in "definite case".

3) In Possibility case, either "can" or "possible" word must be present.

the correct answer is option 3 i.e. Only conclusion I follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45d0e2b3c3f3bfd0c1b112f92114484e675513633c7e78be2c250397c6f1d4d8.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some balloons are rocks → True.

II. Some watches are oceans → False (As per diagram, no relation is between watches and oceans)

III. All oceans are rocks → False (Some oceans are rocks is true)

Hence, the correct answer is Only conclusion I follows.

questions.question: A plastic toy costs Rs. 7 and a plastic spoon costs Rs. 5. A person X spends Rs. 38 on these plastic items. Find the number of plastic toys he/she purchased.
questions.solution:
EXPLANATION:

The purchase value of 1 plastic toy and spoon = Rs. 7 + Rs. 5 = Rs. 12

Now, Value of 2 Plastic toys and 2 Spoon = 12 × 2 = Rs. 24

Given, X spends Rs. 38

Remaining amount (after purchasing 2 Plastic toys and 2 Spoon) = 38 – 24 = Rs. 14

So, only 2 plastic toys can be purchased from the above amount.

∴ Required number of Plastic toys = 2 + 2 = 4

Hence, the correct answer is **"4"**.

questions.question: If x + y + z = 19, xyz = 216 and xy + yz + zx = 114, then the value of √(x³ + y³ + z³ + xyz) is:
questions.solution:
Given x + y + z = 19 and xy + yz + zx = 114

Consider, x + y + z = 19

Squaring on both sides, we get

(x + y + z)² = (19)²

x² + y² + z² + 2(xy + yz + zx) = 361

⇒ x² + y² + z² = 361 − 2(xy + yz + zx)

⇒ x² + y² + z² = 361 – 2 × 114 = 133

∴ x² + y² + z² = 133

We know that x³ + y³ + z³ − 3xyz = (x + y + z)( x² + y² + z² − xy − yz − zx)

x³ + y³ + z³ − 3xyz = 19 × [133 – 114]

On adding 4xyz both sides,

x³ + y³ + z³ + xyz = 19 × 19 + 4 × 216 = 1225

Taking square root on both sides,

√(x³ + y³ + z³ + xyz) = √1225 = 35.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** Formula used:

x3 + y3 + z³ = (x + y + z)[(x + y + z)² - 3(xy + yz + zx) + 3xyz

Calculation:

We have-

√(x3 + y3 + z3 + xyz)

⇒ √[(x + y + z){(x + y + z)2 - 3(xy + yz + zx)} + 3xyz+ xyz]

⇒ √19 × (19² - 3 × 114) + 4 × 216

⇒ √19(361 - 342) + 864

⇒ √19 × 19 + 864

⇒ √1225

⇒ 35

∴ The required value is 35.

questions.question: If the nine-digit number 43x1145y2 is divisible by 88, then the value of (3x – 2y), for the smallest value of y, is:
questions.solution:
To check the divisibility by 88,

It should be divisible by 8 and 11.

We know that the last three digits of a number should be divisible by 8.

⇒ The number made from the last three digits without altering their position will be divisible by 8

⇒ Possible values of y are 1, 5 and 9

∵ y is the smallest, the value of y will be 1.

Now, let's check the divisibility rule of 11,

⇒ 4 + x + 1 + 5 + 2 - (3 + 1 + 4 + y)

⇒ 12 + x - 9 = 3 + x

Hence the possible value of x will be 8.

∴ Value of (3x – 2y) = 3 × 8 - 2 × 1 = 22

questions.question: A man spends 72% of his income. If his income increases by 28% and his expenditure increases by 25%, then what is the percentage increase or decrease in his savings (correct to one decimal place)?
questions.solution:
Let the income and expenditure be 100x and 72x respectively.

Savings = Income – Expenditure = 100x – 72x = 28x

New income = 100x + 100 × 28/100 = 128x

New expenditure = 72x + 72x × 25/100 = 90x

New savings = 128x – 90x = 38x

Required percentage = (38x – 28x)/28x × 100 = 35.7%

questions.question: A and B can complete a task in 25 days. B alone can complete 33(1)/(3)\% of the same task in 15 days. In how many days can A alone complete {(4)/({15)}th} of the same task?
questions.solution:
B’s time taken to complete 33(1)/(3)\% or 1/3rd of the total work = 15 days

B’s time taken to do the complete work = 3 × 15 = 45 days

Total work = LCM of (A + B)’s time taken and B’s time taken.

Total work = LCM of 25 and 45 days = 225 units

(A + B)’s efficiency = 225/25 = 9 units/day (∵ efficiency = total work/time taken)

B’s efficiency = 225/45 = 5 units/day

A’s efficiency = (9 – 5) = 4 units/day

{(4)/({15)}th} of the same task = 225 × 4/15 = 60 units

A’s time taken to this work = 60/ 4 = 15 days

questions.question: The Book 'Gulamgiri' was written by:

questions.question: Ottamthullal is a traditional dance form that is popular in the state of ____________.

questions.question: The enzyme, Lipase is produced by which organ of the body?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2, i.e. Pancreas.

__
 
• Lipase is an enzyme that splits fats so the intestines can absorb them.
 
• Lipase hydrolyses fats like triglycerides into their component fatty acid and glycerol molecules.
 
• It is secreted by **Pancreas.**__
 
• Pancreas is a composite gland which acts as both exocrine glands (contains exocrine cells ) and endocrine gland(contains endocrine cells).
 
 
• Endocrine glands secrete chemical substances into the bloodstream or tissues of the body.
 
• Exocrine glands secrete substances onto an epithelial surface by way of a duct.

questions.solution:

• He was prominent as a publicist in the reforming age of the 19th century and remains of lasting interest as a logician and an ethical theorist.
 
• **'Principles of Political Economy**' by John Stuart Mill was one of the most important economics or political economy textbooks of the mid-nineteenth century.
